title: Card and Bank Processing Costs Kept from Courtesy Permit Cancellation Credits (Student Transportation Services)
content:
The district's card and bank processing costs on the family's payments toward a Student Transportation Services courtesy rider permit fee are not credited back when the family cancels. The cost kept is taken out of the cancellation credit together with the processing charge.

| Payment on the assignment, by method | Cost kept |
|---|---|
| each payment made by online card | 3 percent of that payment |
| each payment made by ACH bank draft | 1.00 USD per draft |
| each payment made by personal check or money order | nothing |

The costs of all the assignment's payments are added together. An assignment with no payment keeps nothing.

## Examples (hypothetical payments)

| Payments on the assignment | Cost kept |
|---|---|
| one online card payment of 62.00 | 1.86 |
| two ACH bank drafts of 30.00 each | 2.00 |
| one online card payment of 40.00 and one ACH bank draft of 22.00 | 1.20 and 1.00: 2.20 |
| one money order of 62.00 | nothing |
